dossier_meta.catalog_title: Open Problem: Complexity of 3-colourability of $P_t$-free graphs
dossier_meta.statement_text: Determine the complexity of $3$-colourability of $P_t$-free graphs for $t \geq 8$.
dossier_meta.context_text: Polynomial-time algorithms for 3-colourability of $P_t$-free graphs are known for $t \leq 7$ (combining results for $t \leq 5$, $(k,t)=(3,7)$, and hardness for $P_7$-free graphs). The paper notes this problem remains open for $t \geq 8$, and provides a subexponential-time algorithm as partial progress.
